findings.claim: [P1] Do not treat a highlighted combobox option as a committed value
findings.evidence: w3c-preview-repro.json: on the official W3C editable combobox example, type C, ArrowDown, then select the highlighted Alabama. CLI returns success but the input remains C and aria-expanded remains true. Manual Enter then commits Alabama. aria-selected is also used for popup navigation; this early return bypasses activation. Local fixture independently returned success with commits=0.
findings.layer: built CLI and Chrome page state

findings.claim: [P1] Enforce the deadline on the active-descendant Enter branch
findings.evidence: dogfood.json: with AGENT_BROWSER_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=500, a non-committing active option received 2421 Enter events over 2.513 seconds. The fixture removed the option after 2500 ms to bound the experiment. The unconditional continue avoids every deadline check while the active option remains available. Already reported by the Vercel review on this exact head; review-comments.json records attribution.
findings.layer: built CLI and Chrome page state
findings.source: existing external review plus built-artifact reproduction

findings.claim: [P2] Retain the matched option identity when verifying an unmounted popup
findings.evidence: dogfood.json: request ca for an option value=ca/text=Canada. Trusted click commits Canada and removes the popup; commits=1 and display=Canada, but CLI returns timeout. Post-commit fallback compares the display only against raw request ca and loses the value-to-label relationship it used to select the option.
findings.layer: built CLI and Chrome page state

findings.claim: [P2] Clear the existing filter reliably before typing a replacement on macOS
findings.evidence: independent-dogfood.json: a Chrome combobox starts with Red. Selecting Blue results in ReBlue, input events Red/Re/ReB/ReBl/ReBlu/ReBlue, commits=[], and timeout. The Meta+A CDP chord does not select all in this tested macOS Chrome path, so Backspace deletes only the last character. This new caller needs a verified select-all operation.
findings.layer: built CLI and Chrome page state
findings.source: native independent reviewer and its exact-binary isolated Chrome drive

findings.claim: Popup closure with unchanged filtered text supplies no independent standard commitment signal
findings.evidence: independent-dogfood.json: an initially empty combobox filters on Blue, then a trusted option click commits Blue, closes the popup, and removes its options. The command still times out although commits=[blue] and value=Blue. committed_before_activation was already Blue due to filtering, so requiring a change in text rejects this ordinary successful commit. Cleared after independent challenge: the PR explicitly rejects unverifiable widgets, and this state is indistinguishable from filter cancellation. Keep as a documented coverage/support limitation rather than a blocker.
findings.layer: built CLI and Chrome page state
findings.source: native independent reviewer and its exact-binary isolated Chrome drive

findings.claim: [P1] Verify the live native select after change handlers can replace it
findings.evidence: supplemental-native-rerender.json: native #country change handler replaces the control. select ca returns success, but document.querySelector(#country).value is us and the live selected label is USA. New verification reuses the detached original object_id after input/change, so it confirms an obsolete node instead of the visible control.
